content: <thought>Analyzing the spectrum: the base peak at m/z 276.07 is the monoisotopic ion. A +1 Da peak at 277.07 with ~16 % intensity matches the natural 13C abundance for a molecule containing ~14 carbons, indicating carbon is present. A +2 Da peak at 278.06 with ~34 % intensity matches the characteristic chlorine isotopic pattern (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1, giving an M+2 peak ≈ 32 % of M). No other element shows a distinctive isotopic pattern of comparable magnitude. Therefore the elements that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution are carbon and chlorine.
